Product Features

  • Adjustable headrest: The cushioned headrest is filled with high-density, thick sponge, allowing you to lean back and relax comfortably. The height of the headrest is adjustable, and the adjustable height range is about 12 cm difference. People of different body sizes can find the best comfort point by adjusting the height of the headrest.
  • Ladestation with sockets & USB connections: One of the most practical features is the built-in socket at the head of the bed, where you can charge your mobile phone and tablet before going to bed. At the head of the bed there are integrated USB/Type-C sockets and European plugs.
  • Flexible and spacious storage: The 50 cm high headboard features a cabinet design with four generous compartments. Large storage space below the slats bed with plenty of space for storing blankets, pillows or bedding, slats bed easily liftable through hydraulic cylinder. A Oxford-tuch is attached on the bottom side of the bed to keep dust away.
  • Thoroughly thought-out details: The slat bedrocks are made entirely of solid wood and metal, offering both high strength and high sleep comfort. The soft material of the bed not only provides a pleasant feeling but also effectively reduces damage from sharp edges and corners that you or your family are likely to encounter during use.
  • Detailed information: To reduce the risk of damage, this bed frame is shipped in 2 cartons and these can arrive on different days. If both packages have arrived but parts are missing, please contact customer service. When moving the bed, please lift it instead of dragging it on the floor.***Please note that product colors may vary under different lighting conditions.****
